pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to a losing position; scale-ins are only permitted when the initial position has achieved at least +$10 in floating profit and the structural stop-loss is moved to break-even.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: No order execution allowed unless order book imbalance exceeds 65% and ATR-normalized volatility is below the 20-period moving average.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops once open profit hits +$12.00, securing absolute minimum +$8.00 to force asymmetric $15-$30 payouts.
